findings.title: New silent-cancel branch in processFiles has no test
findings.body: The added line returns `[]` without an error when every file in the failed batch was cancelled. No test in this PR covers it: `useFileAttachments.test.ts` and the composer tests add nothing for a stager that rejects after the user removed the chip. A test that cancels a pending file, then rejects the stager, would pin this. It should assert that no 'Files couldn’t be saved' notice shows. It should also assert that the batch's earlier `errors` entries, such as the size-limit notice for a sibling file, are not expected to show. This early return skips the final `setError(nextError)` at line 595, so those entries are dropped silently.

contracts.action: Composer accepts files during an optimistic send only while an archived chat restores (`takesNextFiles = optimisticSend && restoring`)
contracts.equivalent_path: Earlier gate `optimisticSend` alone (any send awaiting acceptance) in attachBlocked/acceptsFiles/onDragOver/chip remove/picker/menu disabled
contracts.before_after: Before, any optimistic send allowed attaching, and `fileAttachments.preparing` still blocked a second file. Now only a restoring chat allows it, and `preparing` no longer blocks a second file while takesNextFiles. All five gates (attachBlocked, acceptsFiles, dragover, chip remove, picker/menu disabled) were switched consistently. Other ChatComposer callers do not pass `restoring`, so it defaults to false and they keep the stricter gate.
contracts.visible_effect: Attach button and paste work during an archived-chat restore send. They stay disabled during an ordinary send, as the new test at ChatComposer.optimistic.test.tsx:356 asserts.
contracts.failure_mode: `restoring` comes from a ref read during render (ChatWorkspace.tsx:1080). If it flips to false mid-send, the gates close again and files already staged stay in the draft. Nothing is lost.

contracts.action: A held (re-Entered) draft records a key of the next-draft files and is only sent if the key is unchanged
contracts.equivalent_path: The existing text comparison at line 2291 (`textRef.current !== heldSubmit.text`)
contracts.before_after: Before, only the text was compared. Now the sorted ids of staged and pending files are compared too. When they differ, the held submit is cleared and not sent, and the typed text stays in the box for a new Enter. The hold-time key uses the render-time `pendingAttachments` closure and the live attachments ref. They can differ only within one event turn.
contracts.visible_effect: A file removed or swapped after Enter no longer goes out with the earlier message.
contracts.failure_mode: A mismatch drops the held send silently, but the text stays in the box, so nothing is lost. The key is taken without a `delivery` argument, so it reads the durable delivery from storage at call time.

contracts.action: useRestoreSession no longer overwrites the in-flight entry when a restore for the same key is already running
contracts.equivalent_path: restoreInFlight() consumer in useConversation.ts:2428, which awaits the in-flight restore before staging
contracts.before_after: Before, a second call replaced the map entry. Its refusal (OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS) then deleted the entry while the first restore was still pending, so staging proceeded early. Now the first entry stays until the first restore settles. The second call still POSTs and gets its own result. The updated test asserts that ordering.
contracts.visible_effect: Staging waits for the real restore to finish.
contracts.failure_mode: The first restore's `.finally` always deletes the key, so a rejected restore cannot leave a stale entry.

summary: I found no defects in this part and left one low-priority test suggestion. The `restoring` gating in `ChatComposer.tsx`, the held-draft file key and the `useRestoreSession.ts` in-flight fix all hold up when I read them against their callers. The `useConversation.test.tsx` change does exercise the new `useRestoreSession.ts` behaviour. The suggestion is that the new silent-cancel branch at `frontend/src/renderer/hooks/useFileAttachments.ts:582` has no test. I only read the code; I did not run the tests.
